session-logs.note: Where the record of a finished interview session can be found. Point this at wherever your interviewer leaves its output, or leave it unset and hand over a file each time. Change it when you switch to a different interviewer.

interview-method.note: How the person is questioned while a package is prepared. Any interview or elicitation method available in the environment can answer this source, matched by its own name. Prefer one the skill can invoke or read directly; a method only a person can start still works, it is just handed over rather than driven. A method is always referenced and re-read, never stored as a copy. Leave it unset to be offered what is available, or set it to built-in to use the method the plugin ships. This file lists what a method could be; it is read only while one is being chosen, never to interpret one already configured.

grilling.note: Design-tree interview worked in rounds. MIT licensed. Installed copies are found by name wherever they live; this URL is for reaching the method when no local copy resolves, and is carried into the stored value so an interviewer running elsewhere can still read it.
